claims: SpaceX successfully launched 29 Starlink satellites on a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on Thursday, March 19, 2026, at 10:20 a.m. EDT.
Starlink 10-33 featured a first-stage booster landing on a droneship in the Atlantic Ocean.
Starlink 10-33 launched from Space Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40), Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
The booster for Starlink 10-33 was B1077-27.
B1077-27 landed on the "Just Read the Instructions" drone ship.
SpaceX launched 25 Starlink satellites on a Falcon 9 from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on Monday, March 16, 2026.
